# provider-literal-baseline — provider/model literal counts per covered
# module (after stripping comments/docstrings and allow-regions).
# Generated by `tools/provider-literal-lint --all --update-baseline`.
# The lint BLOCKS any covered file that EXCEEDS its count, so this may
# only ratchet DOWN: mark a literal's home (data/adapter/test via an
# allow-region, or move it to catalog data) -> rerun --update-baseline
# -> the number drops. Goal state: every covered module at 0.
